final_message:
I screened all 312 Q4 2024 transactions against the 277-entry sanctions list and wrote the report. It finds 7 Critical items ($2,989,850), 3 High ($984,500), 6 Medium ($6,323,500) and 6 Low ($2,020,800), and recommends a prompt voluntary self-disclosure to OFAC. Five of the Critical items look like apparent U.S. violations (Golden Horizon, Al-Baraka/Bandar Abbas, Qeshm/Kish, Deniz, Bosfor). It also flags that the ledger's line items add up to $70,108,850, not the stated $127,463,850, and that the vessel records conflict with the transaction records.
